note: The machines time budgets apply to (spec 0075). pnpm bench matches the CPU model string (node:os) against `cpu` and the Dawn adapter's vendor, architecture, device and description against `gpu`; SHARD_MACHINE=<name> overrides it. `backend` is what Dawn picks there, and `passTiming` how a GPU slice is checked: by timestamps where passes don't overlap, by ablation where they do (tile-based GPUs).

laptop.note: MacBook, Apple M4, Metal Dawn. A tile-based GPU: per-pass timestamps overlap.

desktop.note: Windows desktop, Ryzen 9 9950X3D (two CCDs that differ in clock and cache), RTX 5060 Ti, D3D12 Dawn.
